title: SloClass
description: The SLO class of a request: which clock it runs on. Classes order from strictest to most lenient.

oneOf.description: Voice turns, at engine priority 0. Policy `leaseholder` never holds or refuses them, and may cap a reply.
Agent loops with a person waiting, at engine priority 1. Policy `leaseholder` does not hold them.

Batch agents and trace replays, at engine priority 2. An admission policy may defer, shed or resubmit them
while realtime needs room.
